stories.title: New Jane Eyre adaptation announced for Storyhouse autumn season
stories.summary: A new stage adaptation of Charlotte Brontë’s Jane Eyre will run at Storyhouse in Chester from Tuesday 10 November to Saturday 21 November 2026. stories.title: Flintshire villages included in Wales and West Utilities gas pipe upgrade plan
stories.summary: Hope and Caergwrle are among the Flintshire villages named in a £6.8 million gas pipe upgrade programme announced by Wales and West Utilities for North Wales over the next 12 months. stories.title: Senedd Members set for £3,000 pay rise after election
stories.summary: Senedd Members will see a pay rise of more than £3,000 following the 2026 Senedd election, with salaries up more than £12,000 since 2021. stories.title: Chester nursing course wins Student Nursing Times Award for curriculum innovation
stories.summary: The University of Chester has won a national nursing education award for a simulated night shift programme that trains student nurses in public health and homelessness. stories.title: Slot rules to be relaxed to cut summer flight cancellations, Government says
stories.summary: The UK Government is consulting on relaxing airport slot rules this summer to give airlines more flexibility to consolidate flights and avoid last-minute cancellations, in response to global uncertainty caused by the Middle East conflict.
